messages:
harpreet: FYI restore for acct-314 failed with 'decrypt AccessDenied' at 04:10. Cloud logs show the job authenticated, but there are no KMS Decrypt audit events for the CMK. anyone seen a silent deny from the proxy?
encops-bot: Incident INC-2026-078 created. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-proxy-deny-checklist
lin: we rolled an RBAC cleanup yesterday that consolidated uploader SAs under svc-storage. Could be alias drift. Proxy returns 403 and never forwards to KMS when mapping misses.
cooper: I pulled proxy logs: `2026-06-12T04:09:58Z WARN req=abc123 principal=svc-storage/uploader mapping=MISS -> 403 no-grant`. That explains missing Decrypt events.
maya: also opening a vuln note: uploader v1 writes `/tmp/backup-plaintext-*` on some hosts before uploading parts. GH-issue #10234 filed. If tmpfile survives crash it's an exposure.
harpreet: immediate steps: 1) create temporary grant for `svc-storage-uploader-abc` for 15m, 2) retry restore, 3) add proxy audit forwarder so denied principals are sent to SIEM.
oncall-bot: Temporary grant created by lin (15m).
lin: after grant, curl test to proxy returns 200 and KMS Decrypt shows up in audit: `protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"`. Restore resumed, 5/6 parts succeeded, one timed out then retried and completed.
cooper: follow-ups: update rename checklist to reconcile key-policy principals, add unit test simulating SA rename that asserts KMS Decrypt audit presence, and implement proxy metric `kms.proxy.denied` + SIEM forwarder.
maya: short-term vulnerabity mitigation: set TMPDIR to `/var/opt/backups/tmp` with 0700 perms and immediate unlink on success. Long-term: switch uploader to streaming encrypt (avoid materializing cleartext).
harpreet: also recommend alert rule: if a backup principal has auth logs but zero KMS Decrypt events for 10m, create a page. Assign owners and schedule postmortem. :thumbsup:
